cards.title: Investigate Categorical Drift in user_contact
cards.rationale: The 'user_contact' table shows categorical drift in 'date_created' and 'date_modified' columns, with low-frequency categories like '2026-02-16 17:05:33.330845' (0.0050%) and '2026-02-18 11:01:33.004525' (0.0050%). This suggests an anomaly in the distribution of these timestamp values, possibly indicating data entry issues or unexpected patterns. Manual investigation is required to understand the root cause and determine appropriate action.
cards.sql: SELECT date_created, date_modified, COUNT(*) FROM user_contact GROUP BY date_created, date_modified ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 10;
